title: One Traveller, Several Vacation Package Products
content:
A traveller may hold more than one packaged holiday at a time, and each package carries its own product, its own payment schedule and its own cancellation ladder. No maximum number of packages one traveller may hold at once is published against the Vacation Package Products.

## What is never pooled between packages

Nothing is aggregated between packages: a deposit paid on one is never moved to another, and a free group place earned on one never reduces the price of another. A traveller named on two packages is still one traveller, and each package charges its own per-traveller amounts in full.

| Held on one package | Effect on another package of the same traveller |
| --- | --- |
| A deposit already paid | none; it stays on the package it was paid against |
| A free group place earned | none; it does not reduce the price of the other package |
| Being named as a traveller | none; each package charges its per-traveller amounts in full |

## The one case in which two packages are looked at together

Two packages departing on the same date for the same party are referred for duplicate review before the deposit is taken, because suppliers hold one allocation against one party. The referral turns on a match of the departure date for the same party, and on nothing else: two packages for the same party departing on different dates are two ordinary packages, and two packages departing on the same date for different parties are likewise two ordinary packages.
